faculty.name: Jennifer Beer
faculty.summary: Studies self-processes, emotion processes, and social cognition to understand how they influence social interactions and decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我过程、情绪过程和社会认知，以了解它们如何影响社交互动和决策。

faculty.name: David M Buss
faculty.summary: Studies human mating strategies, jealousy, and conflict between the sexes using evolutionary psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类择偶策略、嫉妒和性别冲突的进化心理学。

faculty.name: Frances Champagne
faculty.summary: Studies how genes and environment interact to shape neural and behavioral outcomes, with a focus on early life experiences and epigenetic inheritance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因和环境如何相互作用塑造神经和行为结果，重点关注早期生活经历和表观遗传遗传。

faculty.name: Jessica Church-Lang
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive control processes develop over age, using neuroimaging and cognitive tests to relate variability in mental health and academic achievement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制过程随年龄的发展，使用神经成像和认知测试来关联心理健康和学业成就的变异性。

faculty.name: Alexandra L. Clark
faculty.summary: Studies how neighborhood environments and social experiences affect cognitive aging and Alzheimer's disease risk, using longitudinal data and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生活环境和社会经历如何影响认知老化和阿尔茨海默病风险，使用纵向数据和神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: Lawrence K Cormack
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes the motion of objects in 3D space, integrating depth and motion perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理三维空间中的物体运动，整合深度和运动感知。

faculty.name: James Curley
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological basis of social behavior in groups, including long-term changes in brain and physiology due to social status.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究群体中社会行为的神经生物学基础，包括由于社会地位引起的长期大脑和生理变化。

faculty.name: Kaya De Barbaro
faculty.summary: Studies maternal mental health and infant social-emotional development through natural home interactions and wearable sensors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究母婴心理健康和婴儿社会情绪发展，通过自然家庭互动和可穿戴传感器。

faculty.name: Yvon Delville
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of social stress on the development of aggression during puberty, using animal models to understand neurotransmitter systems and neural networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会压力对青春期攻击行为发展的影响，使用动物模型来理解神经递质系统和神经网络。

faculty.name: Juan M Dominguez
faculty.summary: Studies neural and endocrine mechanisms of motivation and reward, focusing on interactions between hypothalamus and dopamine pathways, and sex differences in drug response.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机和奖励的神经内分泌机制，重点关注下丘脑与多巴胺通路的相互作用，以及性别差异在药物反应中的机制。

faculty.name: Michael P Domjan
faculty.summary: Studies basic behavioral mechanisms of learning, Pavlovian conditioning, and the control problem in instrumental conditioning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基本的学习行为机制、经典条件作用以及操作性条件作用中的控制问题。

faculty.name: Audrey Duarte
faculty.summary: Studies age-related changes in episodic memory using EEG, fMRI, and neuropsychological methods, with a focus on racial/ethnic minorities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与年龄相关的 episodic 记忆变化，使用 EEG、fMRI 和神经心理学方法，重点关注种族/民族少数群体。

faculty.name: Nicholas Duran
faculty.summary: Studies the dynamic interplay between cognition, language, and action during complex real-world tasks, using computational tools and multimodal data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知、语言和行动在复杂现实任务中的动态交互，使用计算工具和多模态数据。

faculty.name: Catharine H Echols
faculty.summary: Studies how children use social cues to learn words, comparing linguistic, cognitive, and social factors across cultures and socio-economic statuses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何使用社会线索学习词汇，并比较不同文化、语言和社会经济背景下的语言、认知和社会因素对语言发展的影响。

faculty.name: Andrew Gaudet
faculty.summary: Studies neuroinflammation, axon plasticity, and behavioral changes after spinal cord injury, aiming to improve recovery and repair.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脊髓损伤后的神经炎症、轴突可塑性和行为变化，旨在改善恢复和修复。

faculty.name: Bertram Gawronski
faculty.summary: Studies how people make evaluative, truth, and moral judgments using experimental, survey, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何进行评价、事实和道德判断，使用实验、调查和计算方法。

faculty.name: Francisco Gonzalez-Li
faculty.summary: Studies brain function using electrophysiology and FDG neuroimaging in animals and humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用电生理学和FDG神经影像学研究动物和人类的大脑功能。

faculty.name: Robbe Goris
faculty.summary: Studies how visual cortex processes and represents uncertainty in natural scenes, using neural recordings and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层在自然场景中处理和表示不确定性的方式，使用神经记录和计算模型。

faculty.name: Samuel D Gosling
faculty.summary: Studies how personality is expressed in physical spaces and develops new methods for collecting behavioral data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人格如何在物理空间中表达，并开发新的行为数据收集方法。

faculty.name: Zenzi M. Griffin
faculty.summary: Studies how far in advance people plan words and sentences, affecting speech fluency, and the learning of personal names.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们在说话前计划词汇和句子的程度，影响言语流畅性，以及个人名称的学习。

faculty.name: Andreana P Haley
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of midlife obesity on brain vulnerability and cognitive function, using neuroimaging and interventions like transcranial laser stimulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中年肥胖对大脑脆弱性和认知功能的影响，使用神经影像学和经颅激光刺激等干预措施。

faculty.name: Mary M Hayhoe
faculty.summary: Studies how gaze and visual attention control walking in natural environments, using eye-tracking and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自然环境中注视和视觉注意力如何控制行走，使用眼动追踪和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Marlone D Henderson
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals' subjective construal of negotiation affects their ability to maintain priorities during conflict resolution, and how abstract versus concrete thinking influences social.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体在谈判中的主观认知如何影响其在冲突解决中保持优先事项的能力，以及抽象与具体思维如何影响社会判断和评价。

faculty.name: Lori Holt
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural basis of listening, especially speech, focusing on learning and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉的认知和神经基础，特别是语言，关注学习和注意力的作用。

faculty.name: Theresa A Jones
faculty.summary: Studies brain plasticity and motor recovery after stroke, using animal models and behavioral training.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中风后的脑可塑性和运动恢复，使用动物模型和行为训练方法。

faculty.name: Robert Josephs
faculty.summary: Studies clinical neuroendocrinology, focusing on hormonal mechanisms in mental health disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究临床神经内分泌学，关注激素机制在精神健康障碍中的作用。

faculty.name: Hongjoo Joanne Lee
faculty.summary: Studies the role of the amygdala in conditioned fear and reward processing, using behavioral and neurobiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究杏仁核在条件恐惧和奖励处理中的作用，使用行为和神经生物学方法。

faculty.name: Cristine H Legare
faculty.summary: Studies the interplay between universal human cognition and cultural variations to understand cognitive and cultural evolution.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究普遍的人类认知与文化变异之间的相互作用，以理解认知和文化进化。

faculty.name: Jarrod Lewis-Peacock
faculty.summary: Studies how the human brain supports goal-directed behavior, focusing on working memory and cognitive control using neuroimaging and computational techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何支持目标导向行为，重点关注工作记忆和认知控制，使用神经成像和计算技术。

faculty.name: Cindy M Meston
faculty.summary: Studies sexual psychophysiology, sexual function and dysfunction, and the effects of sexual abuse on women’s sexual arousal.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性生理学、性功能障碍以及性虐待对女性性唤起的影响。

faculty.name: Marie-H. Monfils
faculty.summary: Studies how fear memories can be attenuated and the social transmission of information and affiliative kinship in rats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐惧记忆的持久抑制以及信息的社会传递和亲和性在大鼠中的作用。

faculty.name: Desmond Ong
faculty.summary: Studies how people use AI for social and emotional support, including everyday empathy and mental health therapy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何使用AI进行社会和情感支持，包括日常同理心和心理健康疗法。

faculty.name: Caitlin Orsini
faculty.summary: Studies how neural mechanisms, particularly in the basolateral amygdala, ventral hippocampus, and prefrontal cortex, affect decision making and fear persistence, using animal models and hormonal.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经机制，特别是基底外侧杏仁核、腹侧海马和前额叶皮层，如何影响决策和恐惧持久性，使用动物模型和激素调节。

faculty.name: Franco Pestilli
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain’s structural connections support perception, cognition, learning and development, using computational methods and neuroimaging data analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑结构连接如何支持知觉、认知、学习和发育，使用计算方法和神经影像数据分析。

faculty.name: Alison Preston
faculty.summary: Studies how the hippocampus and frontoparietal cortices work together to form new knowledge and support memory in adults and adolescents, using fMRI and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究海马体和前顶叶皮层如何在成人和青少年中协同工作以形成新知识并支持记忆，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和计算建模。

faculty.name: Katherine Schaumberg
faculty.summary: Studies risk factors and treatments for eating disorders, focusing on adaptive versus maladaptive eating and physical activity patterns.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究饮食障碍的风险因素和治疗方法，重点关注适应性与病理性饮食和身体活动模式。

faculty.name: Eyal Seidemann
faculty.summary: Studies the cortical mechanisms of visual perception and behavior using optical imaging, electrophysiology, and computational models in awake primates.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类大脑皮层的视觉感知和行为机制，使用光学成像、电生理学和计算模型在清醒的灵长类动物中进行研究。

faculty.name: Jasper Smits
faculty.summary: Develops and evaluates interventions for anxiety and related problems, integrating clinical science and implementation research.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和评估焦虑及相关问题的干预措施，结合临床科学和实施研究。

faculty.name: Hayoung Song
faculty.summary: Studies how brain circuits and systems give rise to cognition, focusing on memory and attention using fMRI and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑电路和系统如何产生认知，重点关注记忆和注意力，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和计算模型。

faculty.name: Michael J Telch
faculty.summary: Studies the nature and treatment of panic, phobias, and anxiety disorders using clinical trials, prospective longitudinal risk studies, and experimental psychopathology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐慌、恐惧症和焦虑障碍的本质及其治疗方法，采用临床试验、前瞻性纵向风险研究和实验性心理病理学方法。

faculty.name: Katharine Tillman
faculty.summary: Studies how children acquire abstract concepts, focusing on time, color, number, and causality, using cognitive development methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何获得抽象概念，包括时间、颜色、数字和因果关系，采用认知发展方法。

faculty.name: Adela Timmons
faculty.summary: Studies mental health processes and interventions using ambulatory assessment, wearable technologies, and artificial intelligence to understand and improve everyday life.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理健康过程和干预措施，使用可穿戴技术、生态评估和人工智能来理解并改善日常生活。

faculty.name: Elliot Tucker-Drob
faculty.summary: Studies how genes and social experiences influence cognitive function, personality, and academic achievement across the lifespan.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因和社会经验如何影响认知功能、人格发展和学业成就的生命周期.

faculty.name: Jacqueline D Woolley
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop their understanding of reality, superstition, and imagination through social and cognitive processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会和认知过程发展对现实、迷信和想象的理解。

faculty.name: David S. Yeager
faculty.summary: Studies how social-cognitive development influences adolescent behaviors such as motivation and engagement, using psychological interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知发展如何影响青少年的行为，如动机和参与度，并使用心理干预方法进行研究。

faculty.name: Chen Yu
faculty.summary: Studies how perception, action, and social interaction develop and learn through visual attention and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉、动作和社会互动如何通过视觉注意和机器学习发展和学习。

faculty.name: Charles J Holahan
faculty.summary: Studies stress and coping mechanisms, focusing on factors that predict health outcomes and addictive behaviors in adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力和应对机制，重点关注预测健康结果和成瘾行为的因素。

faculty.name: Marc S Lewis
faculty.summary: Studies medical problem solving and develops novel ideas in science, medicine, and engineering, focusing on genetic searches and diagnostic instruments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究医学问题解决并开发科学、医学和工程领域的新型想法，重点关注基因搜索和诊断仪器。

faculty.name: William B Swann
faculty.summary: Studies identity fusion and its effects on group behavior and extreme pro-group actions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究身份融合及其对群体行为和极端亲群体行为的影响。

faculty.name: Chandrajit Bajaj
faculty.summary: Develops algorithms in geometric modeling for imaging data sciences and data visualization.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发几何建模算法，用于成像数据科学和数据可视化。

faculty.name: Adela Ben-yakar
faculty.summary: Develops femtosecond laser techniques for nerve regeneration and early cancer detection, using two-photon fluorescence microscopy.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发飞秒激光技术用于神经再生和早期癌症检测，使用双光子荧光显微镜。

faculty.name: Blake Bordelon
faculty.summary: Studies learning in large neural networks and theoretical neuroscience, focusing on convex hulls and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大型神经网络和理论神经科学，关注凸包和机器学习。

faculty.name: Julia Campbell
faculty.summary: Studies the plasticity of sensory processing in the brain, focusing on auditory and visual processing in children and adults with hearing loss and tinnitus.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中感觉处理的可塑性，重点关注听力损失和耳鸣儿童及成人的听觉和视觉处理。

faculty.name: Josh Cisler
faculty.summary: Studies emotional and cognitive mechanisms of anxiety disorders using fMRI and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍的情绪和认知机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和计算方法。

faculty.name: Laura Colgin
faculty.summary: Studies how brain rhythms coordinate neuronal populations during learning and memory, using electrophysiology and behavior in rodent models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑节律如何协调神经元群体在学习和记忆中的活动，使用电生理学和行为学方法在啮齿动物模型中进行.

faculty.name: Samuel Cooper
faculty.summary: Studies maladaptive fear and anxiety mechanisms in adults and adolescents, using computational approaches and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成人和青少年不良恐惧和焦虑机制，使用计算方法和神经影像学。

faculty.name: Jennifer Donegan
faculty.summary: Studies how stress affects neural circuits associated with psychiatric disorders, using techniques like optogenetics and behavioral testing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力如何影响与精神疾病相关的神经回路，使用光遗传学和行为测试等技术。

faculty.name: Manoj Doss
faculty.summary: Studies the neurocognitive mechanisms of psychoactive drugs, focusing on psychedelics and their impact on learning and memory, and the efficacy of psychedelic therapy in depression and PTSD.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神活性药物的基本神经认知机制，特别是致幻剂对学习和记忆的影响，以及致幻剂疗法在抑郁症和创伤后应激障碍中的疗效。

faculty.name: Michael Drew
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain forms and retrieves memories, focusing on the hippocampus in mice using genetic tools and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成和检索记忆，重点研究小鼠的海马体，使用遗传工具和行为实验。

faculty.name: Joseph Dunsmoor
faculty.summary: Studies how emotion and cognition interact in learning and memory, using fMRI, virtual reality, and translational cognitive neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪和认知如何在学习和记忆中相互作用，使用功能性磁共振成像、虚拟现实和转化认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Thomas W. Elston
faculty.summary: Studies how the prefrontal cortex interacts with other brain areas to enable cognitive control, using brain-computer interfaces.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层与其他脑区如何交互以实现认知控制，并利用脑-机接口进行生理认知交互。

faculty.name: Laura K. Fonken
faculty.summary: Studies how immune, nervous, and endocrine systems interact to regulate cognitive and mood behaviors, focusing on neuroinflammation in aging and circadian regulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究免疫、神经系统和内分泌系统如何相互作用以调节认知和情绪行为，重点关注衰老过程中的神经炎症以及昼夜节律的调节作用。

faculty.name: Greg Fonzo
faculty.summary: Studies neurobiological mechanisms of affective disorders and designs treatment approaches, using clinical research and evidence-based psychotherapy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情感障碍的神经生物学机制并设计治疗方法，采用临床研究和基于证据的心理治疗。

faculty.name: Nace Golding
faculty.summary: Studies auditory computations in the brain, focusing on dendritic processing and synaptic integration in binaural neurons.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉系统中的计算过程，重点在于双耳神经元的树突处理和突触整合。

faculty.name: Kristen Harris
faculty.summary: Studies the structural components of synaptic plasticity and memory consolidation in the hippocampus, using electrophysiology and electron microscopy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究海马区突触可塑性和记忆巩固的结构成分，使用电生理学和电子显微镜技术。

faculty.name: Maya Henry
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of spoken and written language in aphasia, exploring rehabilitation strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究失语症中的口头和书面语言的认知和神经基础，探索康复策略。

faculty.name: Ted Ho
faculty.summary: Studies aging and neurodegenerative diseases using optogenetics and neural activity imaging, with a focus on cognitive decline in Alzheimer’s disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究衰老和神经退行性疾病，使用光遗传学和神经活动成像技术，重点关注阿尔茨海默病中的认知衰退。

faculty.name: Johann (Hans) Hofmann
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and hormonal mechanisms of social behavior in African cichlid fishes using gene expression profiling, neuroanatomical techniques, and bioinformatics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲慈鲷鱼类的社会行为背后的分子和激素机制，使用基因表达谱分析、神经解剖技术和生物信息学工具。

faculty.name: Ayland Letsinger
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological regulation of physical activity motivation in mice, using fiber photometry, chemogenetics, and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠运动动机的神经生物学调节，使用光纤光度法、化学遗传学和机器学习技术。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Lippard
faculty.summary: Studies brain-behavior relationships in development, focusing on genes and environmental stress in affective and alcohol use disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发展过程中大脑与行为的关系，重点关注情绪障碍和酒精使用障碍中的基因和环境压力因素。

faculty.name: Regina Mangieri
faculty.summary: Studies how ethanol exposure affects brain physiology and synaptic transmission, using behavioral testing and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究酒精暴露如何影响大脑生理和突触传递，使用行为测试和电生理学技术。

faculty.name: Michela Marinelli
faculty.summary: Studies the biological bases of addiction using a systems-approach that combines molecular, cellular, anatomical, and behavioral studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾的生物学基础，采用结合分子、细胞、解剖和行为研究的系统方法。

faculty.name: Michael Mauk
faculty.summary: Studies mechanisms of learning and plasticity in the cerebellum and prefrontal cortex using behavioral studies, in vivo recordings, and large-scale computer simulations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小脑和前额叶皮层的学习和可塑性机制，使用行为研究、在体记录和大规模计算机模拟。

faculty.name: Jacie McHaney
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of speech processing challenges in noisy environments using neurophysiological and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究嘈杂环境中语音处理挑战的神经机制，使用神经生理学和计算方法。

faculty.name: Esther Melamed
faculty.summary: Studies genetic, environmental, and sex differences in multiple sclerosis, advancing patient-specific treatments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多发性硬化症的遗传、环境和性别差异，推进个性化治疗方法。

faculty.name: Robert Messing
faculty.summary: Studies molecular and circuit neuroadaptations to drugs of abuse, using genetic and electrophysiological methods to identify drug targets for addiction and co-morbid disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾及其共病障碍的分子和电路适应性，使用遗传和电生理方法来识别药物靶点。

faculty.name: Risto Miikkulainen
faculty.summary: Studies biologically-inspired computation, including neuroevolution and deep learning, to understand and develop intelligent systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物启发的计算，包括神经进化和深度学习，以理解并开发智能系统。

faculty.name: José del R. Millán
faculty.summary: Develops noninvasive brain-computer interfaces (BCI) to control robots and promote brain reorganization in motor rehabilitation.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发非侵入式脑机接口（BCI）以控制机器人并促进运动康复中的大脑重组。

faculty.name: Marie Monfils
faculty.summary: Studies how fear memories can be reduced and the factors behind social bonding and information transmission.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐惧记忆的减少机制以及社会纽带和信息传递的因素。

faculty.name: Hitoshi Morikawa
faculty.summary: Studies neural plasticity in the mesostriatal dopaminergic system to understand reward-based learning and addiction, using electrophysiology and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多巴胺系统中的神经可塑性，以理解基于奖励的学习和成瘾行为，使用电生理学和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Luis Natividad
faculty.summary: Studies the neuroproteome to understand addiction and disease, using mass spectrometry and in vivo neuropharmacology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾和疾病中的神经蛋白质组，使用质谱和体内神经药理学方法。

faculty.name: Hiroshi Nishiyama
faculty.summary: Studies the formation, maintenance, and rewiring of synaptic connections in the mammalian brain, particularly during development and adulthood.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物大脑中突触连接的形成、维持和重编，特别是在发育和成年期。

faculty.name: Kimberly Nixon
faculty.summary: Studies alcohol use disorder by examining neuroprotective agents and the role of adult neural stem cells and microglia in brain damage and recovery.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究酒精使用障碍，通过探讨神经保护剂以及成年神经干细胞和小胶质细胞在大脑损伤和恢复中的作用。

faculty.name: David Paydarfar
faculty.summary: Develops biosensors and algorithms to track and predict patient health, aiding in disease trajectory forecasting.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发生物传感器和算法以跟踪和预测患者健康状况，帮助预测疾病轨迹。

faculty.name: Steven Phelps
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution of social behavior and neural mechanisms in rodents, particularly prairie voles and singing mice, using behavioral, molecular, and computational approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物（尤其是原野鼠和鸣鼠）的社会行为和神经机制的进化，采用行为学、分子生物学和计算模型等方法。

faculty.name: Nicholas Priebe
faculty.summary: Studies how visual cortex processes motion, orientation, and depth, using electrophysiology and imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层如何处理运动、方向和深度信息，使用电生理学和成像技术。

faculty.name: Samantha SantaCruz
faculty.summary: Develops brain-computer interfaces and neuromodulation devices to understand and control neural dynamics, using computational models and experimental neuroengineering.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发脑-机接口和神经调节设备，以理解和控制神经动力学，使用计算模型和实验神经工程方法。

faculty.name: Thibaud Taillefumier
faculty.summary: Studies the collective properties and design principles of neural networks using optimization theory and stochastic dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经网络的集体性质和设计原理，使用优化理论和随机动力学方法。

faculty.name: Huiliang Wang
faculty.summary: Designs functional nanomaterials and electronic devices for neural interfaces and clinical disease treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计功能性纳米材料和电子设备用于神经接口和临床疾病治疗。

faculty.name: Xuexin Wei
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain supports adaptive and intelligent behavior using computational and statistical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持适应性和智能行为，采用计算和统计方法。
